subject: New Police Station Loan Order
overview: The City Council approved the first reading of a loan order to finance architectural services for a new police station following extensive debate and commitments regarding fire department facilities. The council also approved an ordinance requiring Tufts University to report student housing addresses, established the 2017 election calendar, and acted on several community maintenance resolutions.

items.title: Citation for Reverend Noah Evans
items.summary: The council presented a citation and commendations to Reverend Noah Evans of Grace Episcopal Church upon his departure from the community.

items.title: Grant Writer Resolution
items.summary: A resolution requesting the administration hire a full-time qualified grant writer passed.

items.title: Floodplain Status Update for 90 Main Street
items.summary: The council passed a resolution requesting an update and cost analysis regarding floodplain concerns at the proposed police station site.

items.title: Owner's Project Manager Update
items.summary: A resolution requesting an update on the selection of an Owner's Project Manager for the proposed police station project passed.

items.title: Police Station Architectural Services Loan Order
items.summary: The council approved the first reading of a loan order for architectural design services for a new police station following mayoral commitments to address fire station planning. Related resolutions passed requesting mold testing at fire headquarters, a project timeline, and a multi-group study on public safety facilities.

items.title: Tufts Student Housing Reporting Ordinance
items.summary: The council passed the third reading of an ordinance requiring Tufts University to submit student housing addresses and occupancy counts to assist code enforcement.

items.title: Police Station Plan Presentation Funding Account
items.summary: A resolution passed requesting the specific line item or account used to pay consultants for public police station presentations.

items.title: Roosevelt Circle Graffiti Removal
items.summary: A resolution requesting MassDOT remove graffiti and provide a maintenance schedule for Roosevelt Circle passed.

items.title: Linden Street Throughway Opinion
items.summary: A resolution passed requesting a legal opinion from the city solicitor regarding requirements to turn Linden Street into a throughway.

items.title: Royal Park Wall and Gate Repairs
items.summary: A resolution requesting a cost estimate to repoint the wall and reinstall wrought iron gates at Royal Park passed.

items.title: Planet Aid Donation Boxes Maintenance
items.summary: A resolution addressing overflowing donation boxes was referred to the Subcommittee on Zoning and Ordinances.

items.title: Condolences for Anna Consolino
items.summary: The council expressed condolences and held a moment of silence for West Medford business figure Anna Consolino.

items.title: 2017 Municipal Election Calendar
items.summary: The council approved the key dates for the 2017 municipal election schedule and requested meals for poll workers.

items.title: War Memorial Park Plaques Re-commemoration
items.summary: A resolution announcing the re-commemoration of veteran plaques and requesting funds for plaque repairs passed.

items.title: Public Participation on Medford History
items.summary: Resident Jeanne Martin spoke to the council regarding indigenous history and the legacy of colonial slavery in Medford.
